subject: Demo + Procurement/Security Sync — overlap windows for APAC/EU/US
messages:
From: Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@nebulacloud.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nebulacloud.com, security@nebulacloud.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: full-stack demo + procurement/security Q&A (AE/SE + infra engs)

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. NebulaCloud is interested in a single session that covers: hosted API walkthrough + deployment patterns (Dedicated/Private), procurement questions on pricing model, and a short security/QoS review for our compliance team. Attendees will include two infra engineers (US), procurement (US), and security (EU).

Can we find a 75-minute window next week that hits late morning US West / evening EU so both sets can attend? Our ideal windows are:
- Tue 8/31: 11:00–12:30 PT (19:00–20:30 CEST)
- Wed 9/1: 09:00–10:15 PT (17:00–18:15 CEST) — if you can start earlier

We also want one SE on the call for a live model routing demo and to answer integration questions. Please loop them in and share a proposed agenda + any pre-read.

Best,
Alex
Alex Zhao
Staff Infra Engineer, NebulaCloud
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@nebulacloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, procurement@nebulacloud.com, security@nebulacloud.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: full-stack demo + procurement/security Q&A (AE/SE + infra engs)

Alex — thanks, this is helpful. Marissa (SE) and Rishi (solutions lead) are looped.

We can do either window but recommend a slightly longer slot (80 min) to leave time for procurement questions and a short security deep-dive. Proposed schedule:
- 0–10m: introductions + success criteria (AE)
- 10–40m: SE demo — routing, dedicated vs hosted, live token/latency numbers
- 40–55m: integration patterns + telemetry (SE)
- 55–70m: procurement (pricing, SLAs)
- 70–80m: security Q&A (security contacts)

Availability from our side:
- Tue 8/31 11:00–12:40 PT — Marissa available, Rishi can join last 30 mins
- Wed 9/1 09:00–10:30 PT — Rishi available full time; Marissa needs to start by 09:15 PT

If you prefer, we can rotate the session times over future calls (we've done a rotating-demo cadence for global teams) — happy to propose a recurring rota if this looks like a multi-step eval.

I'll attach a short agenda and a SOC2 snapshot for review. Let me know which slot you prefer and if security needs a formal questionnaire ahead of time.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@nebulacloud.com>, procurement@nebulacloud.com, security@nebulacloud.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: full-stack demo + procurement/security Q&A (AE/SE + infra engs)

Diego / Rishi / Alex — quick note on content and live demo posture.

For the live demo I propose we do:
- a short cold-start request against hosted API to show latency numbers (same prompt for baseline)
- a demo of routing policy in the Console that fails over to a cheaper quantized model (to show graceful degradation)
- 5–7 minute walkthrough of Dedicated config and autoscale profile (with typical throughput numbers at 512 tokens)

If we take Tue 8/31 11:00 PT, I can do the full demo. If we go Wed 9/1 09:00 PT I’ll need to join at 09:15 PT and will start with the routing demo.

Also: security asked to see our keystore/KMS integration brief — I uploaded a 2-page snapshot to the Drive link Diego shared.

-Marissa
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: procurement@nebulacloud.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@nebulacloud.com>, security@nebulacloud.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 20:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: full-stack demo + procurement/security Q&A (AE/SE + infra engs)

Hi Diego,

Procurement confirms Tue 8/31 11:00–12:40 PT works for us (we'll block 11:00–13:00 local for padding). Two quick asks before the call:
1) Can you share proposed licensing tiers and an example committed-capacity price sheet so finance can pre-read?
2) Please include the DocuSign link for your standard MSA (even if we don't sign immediately) so legal can scan for redlines.

Thanks,
On behalf of Procurement — Lia Chen
Procurement Manager, NebulaCloud
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: procurement@nebulacloud.com, Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@nebulacloud.com>, security@nebulacloud.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 01:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full-stack demo + procurement/security Q&A (AE/SE + infra engs)

Lia / Alex — great, booked Tue 8/31 11:00–12:40 PT. Calendar invite will follow.

Quick follow-ups:
- Attached: Redwood-demo-agenda.pdf and SOC2-snapshot-Redwood.pdf (also on Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/nebula/demo-agenda-2026-08)
- Pricing: I'm attaching a committed-capacity example and a short one-pager on pricing bands. I'll send the DocuSign MSA link by EOD.
- Rotation/ops note: Marissa / Rishi — please confirm if you'd like me to record the session and share a short 20-min follow-up for APAC colleagues who can't attend the live slot. If yes, we'll mark it as \"recorded for internal review only\" and drop it in the Nebula shared Drive.

Thanks everyone — aiming to keep the call tightly scoped so procurement/security have time for Q&A.

— Diego
From: Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@nebulacloud.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nebulacloud.com, security@nebulacloud.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 15:04:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: full-stack demo + procurement/security Q&A (AE/SE + infra engs)

Diego — confirmed, thanks. Tue 8/31 11:00 PT works. We do want the session recorded for APAC; please go ahead. Procurement: Lia — thanks for pre-reading the pricing. Security — we'll compile any high-level questions and send them before Monday so you can triage.

Couple of small asks: can the agenda call out who will answer KMS/integration questions (Marissa or Rishi)? Also, will you flag any follow-up engineering artifacts (e.g., sample rolling config) we should expect after the call?

Look forward to it.

Alex
